subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Vehicle-oriented physics, race-state, collision-effect and transform code sharing the active-vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 (count dword_5C329C, end sentinel byte_7C5690, player pointer dword_7C54E0 / dword_7C54E8) and a family of packed fixed-point / Euler orientation codecs. The twenty-one functions cover a HUD suspension-temperature gauge, an AI nearest-vehicle scan, a collision-avoidance state machine, the packed orientation/bitfield codec pair, vehicle identity and lifetime accessors, vehicle-object construction, the collision spark/trail particle emitters and dispatch, wheel-contact particle lookup, vehicle slot activation, a matrix transform composer, the lap-gap state update, race-progress counting and completion checks, a physics constant seeder, a particle-emitter world transform, a camera point transform helper, and suspension geometry initialisation. Most owner classes are UNKNOWN in the packet; the groupings below are DERIVED/GUESS from shared field evidence or structural idiom.

summary: Proposes seventeen classes over the twenty-one validated functions. VehicleObject (0x004C6920) is the only packet-derived owner class and covers construction. PackedOrientationCodec (0x004B2DD0, 0x004B32A0) groups the structural twin sharing the unpack/bitfield tail (0.000030517578 scale, FloatToBitfieldPack / BitfieldInsert / saturated int16 pack). CollisionParticleEffectManager (0x004CB620, 0x004CE3E0, 0x004CE930) groups the collision spark/trail emitters that share the slot pointers this+0x20/0x24/0x28, the effect slot array this+0x3C/0x40, the throttle globals (dword_7CF8A8, dword_8AB6E4, dword_7C5698) and the flt_8AB274 / dword_8AAE70 jitter source. RaceCompletionMonitor (0x004DA990, 0x004DAD80) groups the progress-count and finished-check pair. The remaining roles are singletons proposed as GUESS owners: SuspensionTelemetryGauge, VehicleProximityScanner, VehicleCollisionAvoidanceController, VehicleIdentityComparer, VehicleLifetimeStateAccessor, WheelContactParticleLookup, ParticleWorldTransform, VehicleSlotActivator, TransformMatrixComposer, VehicleLapGapStateTracker, PhysicsConstantSeed, CameraTransform (packet-derived), and SuspensionGeometryInitializer. Three interfaces expose the shared services: VehicleArrayService, CollisionEmitterService and PackedOrientationCodecHelpers. Ownership beyond VehicleObject and CameraTransform is unresolved and must not be treated as CONFIRMED.

function_roles.role: Render one corner's suspension/temperature gauge into draw surface a2. Gate the active branch on the per-corner input state at dword_7C54E0 + 296*a1 (non-zero dword at +2100 and non-zero byte at +2164); inactive corners blink red on parity CRTFtol(dbl_8AFEA0) % 2. When the per-car dword at +18580 of the car selected by dword_7C54DC equals that of the car selected by dword_7C54E4, draw three color-encoded segments built from the corner temperature table at 8157696 (Kelvin minus 273.16 through FloatToColorEncoding) via RenderDrawOperationWithClipping; otherwise draw the whole bar in fixed green (-16711936) and return the draw result.

Scan the active-vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 (end sentinel byte_7C5690) for the candidate whose speed/distance delta from the target vehicle (slot index a2) is the smallest positive value. Live candidates go through AIDelegateCall (0x0042ADD0) then SpeedDeltaComputation (0x00426CC0); null slots whose base state at +13000 != 1 fall back to the base vehicle value at +15016 through SpeedDeltaComputation. Positive-delta clamp from flt_59E440. Returns the winning vehicle pointer, or 0 when the target slot is null. Called by OpponentProximityScanTeamRecognition (0x0042A7D0).

Per-frame collision-avoidance state machine. With the avoidance sub-object at this+0x14 present, read the movement-threshold flag at *this + 0x39A0, obtain the position-change monitor (0x004E9630) on the object base + 12, compute the normalized movement delta between predicted and current position, and for every active vehicle (count dword_5C329C, array dword_7C54F0, activity byte at +13388) test the approach-time ratio 0 < t < 5.5 via dot products with the own direction at obj+0x34E0/0x34E4/0x34E8 and the other vehicle's direction at +13560/+13564/+13568. On predicted collision the collision flag is cleared; otherwise the state transitions 1 -> 2 and optionally raises a flag-field bit (FlagFieldBitManipulation when sub-object flag index [25] is set), and a collision detected while in state 2 invokes the utility handler on the sub-object. Returns the current state value.

Convert packed Euler/orientation data from the fixed-point struct this into a float triple at a2+8/+12/+16 plus two bitfield-packed values, storing a3 at a2+4 and returning it. Scale int16 at this+9/+11/+13 by 0.015625, round-trip through UtilityFunction_2480 (0x004B2480), FloatToFixedConversionWithClamp (0x004B25D0) and FloatToShortClampedConversion (0x004B2750); when the direction vector is non-zero build an orthonormal basis: unpack this+0/+2/+4/+8 scaled by 0.000030517578, derive a normal via CollisionNormalFromFeature (0x0044C550, global 0x007C9360) with a default-axis fallback, extract Euler angles via atan2 with gimbal handling (FloatConvertWrapper 0x00588570), pack via FloatToInt16SaturationPack (0x004B31A0), and write the bitfield parameters through TernarySelectByBitfield (0x004B2BF0)/BitfieldInsert (0x004B29B0) and sub_4B2C50 (0x004B2C50)/FloatToBitfieldPack (0x004B2930). Called by FloatComputation (0x00464B40) and CollisionStateUpdate (0x00500010).

Pack a fixed-point triple from struct this into floats and through the bitfield pipeline at output a2. Round-trip a2+8 through UtilityFunction_2480 (0x004B2480), FloatToFixedConversionWithClamp (0x004B25D0) and FloatToShortClampedConversion (0x004B2750); unpack this+0/+2/+4/+8 scaled by 0.000030517578 into v12/v13/v14; process via sub_4B2310 (0x004B2310); pack two bitfield parameters via TernarySelectByBitfield/BitfieldInsert (0x004B2BF0/0x004B29B0) and sub_4B2C50/FloatToBitfieldPack (0x004B2C50/0x004B2930). Writes a3 to a2+4 and returns the bitfield-pack result. Called by CollisionStateUpdate (0x00500010) during collision geometry setup.

Thiscall identity/path comparison on two strings: find the null terminator of the path string at a2+18196, scan back for the last backslash (92), compare the trailing filename with the string at this+65 and the string at this+1 with the string at a2+17952; returns true when both match (whole-path compare when no backslash is present). Invoked by VehicleInstanceListBuilder (0x004B5C50).

Minimal accessor: dereference this to obtain the target object stored at this+0x0, load the float at object+0xF30, and return it. No branches, guards, globals or callees. Callers 0x0047C940, 0x0047C960, 0x0047DBE0.

Vehicle-object constructor: RaceStructInit (0x00423E80) zero-initialises the struct, write this[4645] (offset 0x4894) = -1 (all bits set) to mark the handle/ID unset, VehicleDriverInfoClear (0x004C79E0) clears the driver-info substructure, and LargeStructFieldSetterWithStoredReference (0x00424040) stores a persistent self-reference; returns this. Called by RepeatedCallLoop (0x0042BB50).

Spawn a spark particle at a collision contact point. Compute the contact magnitude from the direction vector a4; when magnitude >= 1.0 and the slot counter at this+0x58 is positive, allocate a slot from the circular buffer owned by this (0x004CB540), size the spark from the 256-entry trig table (globals 0x008AAE70/0x008AAE74) scaled by a5, compute a collision normal via CollisionNormalFromFeature (0x0044C550, global 0x007C9360) with a fallback, write position/velocity/magnitude into the slot, and publish through the array/flag helpers 0x00558C60/0x00558CB0/0x00558CF0 using this+0xC/+0x10/+0x14 parameters. Called by the collision effect dispatch (0x004CE3E0).

Per-frame collision contact effect dispatch. Gate on ArithmeticComparison_9fb0 (0x004B9FB0) of the dword_8AB6E4 scoring/effects gate; iterate the effect slot array at this+0x40 over the this+0x3C slot count, switching on each slot's type id at slot+4. The spark type id spawns via ParticleCollisionSpark (0x004CB620); trail types spawn via ParticleTrailEmitter (0x004CBC50) with positions jittered from flt_8AB274 through the dword_8AAE70 ring counter. Emission is throttled on dword_7CF8A8 / dword_8AB6E4 / dword_7C5698 (every 20 ticks), deduplicated by the last contact position (a2+56..64) and speed (a2+68), and the byte_7CF9D4 / byte_7CF9EC weather-render flags select the trail magnitude/persistence variant. Callers 0x004472B0 and 0x004EE2D0.

Spawn trail particles from three collision-effect slots (this+0x20/0x24/0x28) when the collision point has moved enough since the last frame. The emitter-mode argument a6 is derived from byte_7CF9BC/byte_7CF9EC (104 when both set, -1 when both clear, otherwise incoming a6); per-slot emission is gated by the collision strength in a2, the slot pointer and the throttle counters (dword_7CF8A8, dword_8AB6E4, dword_7C5698 % 20 == 0). Movement windows: vertical delta beyond 0.15000001 / squared horizontal distance beyond 1.0 (slots 8 and 9), 0.059999999 / 0.16000001 (slot 10). Jittered spawn positions from flt_8AB274 via the dword_8AAE70 ring counter, a5 velocity scaled by 0.1, emitted through ParticleTrailEmitter (0x004CBC50); slot 10 additionally spawns a secondary offset trail (0.0125 backward offset) at high render-throttle detail. Called from 0x004472B0 and 0x004EE2D0.

Search the strided array owned by this (element count this+0x10, first element this+0x14, 108-byte stride) for the first entry whose +4 field equals a3, then spawn a wheel contact particle at that entry via WheelContactParticle (0x004CD6C0). Returns the matched 0-based entry index, the element count when the search exhausts, or 0 for an empty array. Called by AIWaypointPathCheckerRenderer (0x004024F0).

Scan the active-vehicle pointer table dword_7C54F0 over dword_5C329C slots for the first slot whose in-use flag at +0x4064 (16484) is zero, set it to 1 (unless the current value is the sentinel 3), and return the slot base plus 0x4034 (16436); return the slot count when no free slot is found. Matches the ABI lead Set_First_Uninitialized_Vehicle_Active. Called by DispatchChainWithVTableCalls (0x0046DA20) and sub_46DC60 (0x0046DC60).

Build four 4x4 transform matrices on the stack from a2 (negated when positive, against the zero sentinel dbl_59E430), a3 (clamped to [0,1] with bounds dbl_59E420=1.0 and dbl_59E430=0.0) and a4 (scalar power/twist base, stored as a double at this+0x20), combine them via sub_5677B0 (0x005677B0, count 4, coefficient 3.0 from dbl_59E7E0), and write the combined result as eight dwords into this[0x0..0x1C]. On failure zero the eight dwords and set this+0x1C to 1.0f (1072693248). Callers sub_430750, BrakeTemperatureFadeModel (0x00430A50), TireCompoundPerWheelPhysicsApplication (0x0043DA10).

Update a per-vehicle lap-gap state object. Read one of two time values through the player vehicle pointer dword_7C54E0 at offsets 16592/16596, record the chosen source as a byte flag at this+0x18 and the chosen value at this+0x1C, and call LapTimeGapCalculation (0x0049B6D0) to write the gap float at this+0x14. A non-zero gap-calculation return, a gap <= 0.0, or a non-zero gap flag each dispatch VTableDispatchWithFieldClear (0x004D7E30) on this; otherwise fall through returning the gap flag. Invoked from sub_4D9F80 (0x004D9F80).

Count vehicles whose per-vehicle progress field (vehicle_ptr + 16444) meets or exceeds the threshold read from this+0x24. Iterate all vehicles in the global pointer array dword_7C54F0 over indices 0..dword_5C329C-1, incrementing the match count for each progress value >= threshold; returns 0 when dword_5C329C is not positive.

Return whether race completion is confirmed. The result flag starts false and is set true when the race-end condition from ArithmeticComparison_ae80 (0x004DAE80) holds or this+0x20 equals the tally dword_5C329C. When the finished count from CountVehiclesAtOrBeyondLap (0x004DA990) equals the tracked count read from the player vehicle pointer dword_7C54E8 at +16480 and that tracked count has not reached the tally, scan the trailing vehicles (via sub_4D1B50 over dword_8ACEE0 indexing dword_5F073C at stride 4656) under the one-shot flag this+0x28, clearing the result flag if the scan reaches the grid end; write 1 to this+0x28 to mark the check done.

Minimal thiscall constant initializer (structural twin of ConstantReturnSetter 0x004DB100): store the literal 1082130432 (4.0f) into the dword at this+0x10 and return the same literal. Likely seeds a per-object physics/scalar field. Global dword_5ACF5C is recorded as read by facts but does not surface in the raw body.

Transform up to 17 particle-emitter positions from local to world space and spawn particles. Guard on the global particle-system pointer dword_8ACEB8; iterate the emitter array of 17 slots at this+0x998 (7 floats / 28 bytes per slot), and for each slot whose active-flag byte is non-zero rotate the slot position by the 3x3 rotation matrix a2, add the translation a3, and call ParticleSpawnFunction (0x004CCE90) with the global system, world position, slot data and the a4 parameter. Called by sub_4EE2D0 (0x004EE2D0).

Pure 3D math helper with no callees, globals or guards: multiply the 3x3 rotation matrix at this+0x20..0x40 by the vector at this+0x8E8/0x8EC/0x8F0, add a translation offset read just before the matrix (this+0x08/0x0C/0x10 in the raw source), write the result to output a2, and copy this+0x14/0x18/0x1C into output a3; returns a3. Callers 0x00409A00, 0x0040B710, 0x00434D60.

Initialize suspension geometry for a single wheel slot: compute the wheel offset vector by subtracting the chassis local origin (this+0x48/0x4C/0x50) from the input position a3, copy the suspension orientation matrix (0x24 bytes from a4) and the upright orientation matrix (0x24 bytes from a5) into per-wheel geometry storage, and extract Euler angles from both matrices with gimbal-lock handling (fabs of a matrix element equals 1.0 against global 0x0059E420; FloatConvertWrapper 0x00588570; alternate atan2 branch forcing the second angle to 0).

classes.name: VehicleObject

The constructor zero-initialises the struct (RaceStructInit 0x00423E80), marks the handle/ID at +0x4894 unset (-1), clears the driver-info substructure (VehicleDriverInfoClear 0x004C79E0), and stores a persistent self-reference (LargeStructFieldSetterWithStoredReference 0x00424040).

classes.name: SuspensionTelemetryGauge

Reads the per-corner input state object via dword_7C54E0 at a 296-byte stride; inactive corners blink red on parity of the CRTFtol(dbl_8AFEA0) value, active corners draw three color-encoded segments from the corner temperature table or a plain green bar depending on a per-car +18580 comparison. No this-relative fields are evidenced; the object consumed is a global-indexed state block.

classes.name: VehicleProximityScanner

Live candidates evaluate through AIDelegateCall and SpeedDeltaComputation; null slots fall back to the base vehicle data at +15016. No this-relative fields are evidenced.

Gates on the sub-object pointer at this+0x14, reads the movement-threshold flag on the dereferenced object (+0x39A0) and the position-change monitor, computes the normalized movement delta, and tests every other active vehicle's direction for an approaching path (0 < t < 5.5). classes.name: PackedOrientationCodec

Common ownership is structurally clear but the shared owning object is unknown.

Compares the trailing filename of the path at a2+18196 with this+65 and the string at this+1 with a2+17952. The compared strings at this+1 and this+65 are caller-defined and have no packet field evidence.

classes.name: VehicleLifetimeStateAccessor
classes.responsibility: Single-pointer-hop accessor: reads the float at object+0xF30 through the object pointer stored at this+0x0 and returns it. The 'lifetime average' meaning is a DERIVED label from existing analysis and the ABI legacy name; the field could be any scalar quantity. The raw source declares a double return while a 32-bit float is loaded (unreconciled in this packet).

classes.name: CollisionParticleEffectManager
classes.responsibility: Collision-contact particle emitter group. 0x004CB620 spawns spark particles from the circular buffer with trig-table sizing and array/flag publishing; 0x004CE3E0 dispatches per frame over the effect slot array (this+0x3C count, this+0x40 array, type id at slot+4) with throttling and weather-flag selection; 0x004CE930 emits trail particles from three slot pointers (this+0x20/0x24/0x28) under movement and throttle gates. All three share the dword_7CF8A8 / dword_8AB6E4 / dword_7C5698 throttle globals and the flt_8AB274 / dword_8AAE70 jitter source.

No this-relative fields are evidenced.

Stores the input scalar a4 as a double at this+0x20. Callers include a brake-temperature fade model and a tire-compound physics application.

Shares the dword_7C54F0 / dword_5C329C array and count globals.

Structural twin of ConstantReturnSetter (0x004DB100); likely seeds a per-object physics/scalar field. The object identity is unconfirmed and the global dword_5ACF5C may or may not source the constant.

Pure 3D math helper: multiplies the 3x3 rotation matrix at this+0x20..0x40 by the point at this+0x8E8/0x8EC/0x8F0, adds a translation offset (read just before the matrix in the raw source), writes the result to output a2, and copies this+0x14/0x18/0x1C into output a3. The translation addend offsets this+0x08/0x0C/0x10 have no packet field evidence.

classes.name: SuspensionGeometryInitializer
classes.responsibility: Initializes suspension geometry for a single wheel slot: computes the wheel offset vector from the chassis local origin (this+0x48/0x4C/0x50), copies the suspension and upright orientation matrices into per-wheel geometry storage, and extracts Euler angles with gimbal-lock handling.

state_machines.name: VehicleCollisionAvoidanceState
transitions: Clear -> Avoiding: no approaching vehicle within the 0 < t < 5.5 window; when the avoidance state is 1 it advances to 2 and may raise the flag-field bit (FlagFieldBitManipulation) if the sub-object flag is set
Avoiding -> Clear: predicted collision clears the collision flag
Avoiding -> CollisionDetected: a collision predicted while the state is 2 invokes the utility handler on the sub-object
CollisionDetected -> Clear: the per-frame re-entry reevaluates the approach window and resets the flag on the next non-colliding frame

state_machines.name: RaceCompletionCheckState
transitions: NotConfirmed -> Confirmed: race-end condition (ArithmeticComparison_ae80) holds or this+0x20 equals the vehicle tally
NotConfirmed -> TrailingVehicleScan: finished count (CountVehiclesAtOrBeyondLap) equals the tracked count below the tally and the one-shot flag this+0x28 is set
TrailingVehicleScan -> ScanComplete: the walk reaches the grid end; the result flag is cleared and this+0x28 is written to 1
TrailingVehicleScan -> Confirmed: a trailing vehicle is not finished, so the scan halts and the result stays unconfirmed

interfaces.name: VehicleArrayService
interfaces.purpose: Global active-vehicle pointer array dword_7C54F0 (terminated by byte_7C5690, slot count dword_5C329C, player pointer dword_7C54E0 / dword_7C54E8) shared by proximity scanning, slot activation, race-progress counting and the lap-gap update. Consumers index it by slot and read per-slot offsets such as +0x403C (progress), +0x4064 (in-use flag) and +16480 (tracked count).

interfaces.name: CollisionEmitterService
interfaces.purpose: Particle allocation and emission helpers backing the collision-effect dispatch: circular-buffer slot allocation, the collision spark spawner, the trail emitter, the wheel-contact particle spawner and the generic particle spawn.

interfaces.name: PackedOrientationCodecHelpers
interfaces.purpose: Fixed-point/float conversion and bitfield-pack helpers shared by the packed-orientation codec pair: vector load (0x004B2480), clamped fixed/short conversions (0x004B25D0/0x004B2750), bitfield select/insert/pack (0x004B2BF0/0x004B29B0/0x004B2930, 0x004B2C50), saturated int16 pack (0x004B31A0), vector processing (0x004B2310) and the float conversion wrapper (0x00588570).

compatibility_contracts.name: ActiveVehicleArrayContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The active-vehicle pointer array at dword_7C54F0 (slot count dword_5C329C, end sentinel byte_7C5690, player pointer dword_7C54E0 / dword_7C54E8) must remain walkable by index over the slot count, and per-slot offsets +0x403C (progress), +0x4064 (in-use flag) and +16480 (tracked count) must keep their meanings. compatibility_contracts.description: Race completion is confirmed when the race-end condition (ArithmeticComparison_ae80) holds or the stored count at this+0x20 equals the tally; the finished count derives from the per-vehicle progress at vehicle_ptr + 16444 (0x403C) compared with the threshold at this+0x24, and the one-shot trailing-vehicle walk (flag this+0x28) resolves indices through sub_4D1B50 over dword_8ACEE0 indexing dword_5F073C at stride 4656.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionAvoidanceContract

compatibility_contracts.name: PackedOrientationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Packed orientation structs must decode the int16 components at this+9/+11/+13 scaled by 0.015625 and the packed dwords at this+0/+2/+4/+8 scaled by 0.000030517578 into a float triple at output a2+8/+12/+16, producing an orthonormal basis with Euler angles (gimbal fallback) and two bitfield parameters, with a3 stored at a2+4.

compatibility_contracts.name: ParticleEmitterWorldTransformContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The emitter must guard on the global particle-system pointer dword_8ACEB8, walk the 17-slot emitter array at this+0x998 (7 floats per slot), rotate each active slot position by the a2 matrix, add the a3 translation, and spawn through ParticleSpawnFunction (0x004CCE90).
